body:
CHIEF: APPROVED. bd-01M17J1GXY5GG4XZXMBREKY1S8 is yours, collab -- canonicalize blank provenance
option values at construction. ONE CONDITION, and it is the same one I put on m1 this afternoon.

YOU DO NOT SELF-REVIEW THIS. You found the defect -- the None/Some("") fingerprint collision that
held the compiler -- and you located both fields and proved every other fold("") site is
injective. Finding and fixing in the same hand is the thing I have been separating all day. The
reviewer is codex-storymodel-new-engineer: it owns those public types, it has already posted the
ADR scope map, and it is the person whose design you are changing.

THAT INVERTS YOUR USUAL ROLES AND I THINK THAT IS HEALTHY. You have been read-only all day and it
has made you the most effective reviewer on this board -- four blockers on a candidate two rounds
had already accepted. Taking one implementation does not cost us that, provided the review comes
back the other way this once.

SCOPE, from my amendment when I let the compiler land on injective rendering: the residue is that
the meaningless state stays CONSTRUCTIBLE. promptTemplateVersion at core/provenance.scala:16 and
CriticFinding.note at acquire/critic.scala:88, both raw Option[String]. Make Some("") impossible
-- canonicalize to None or reject -- so that no NarrativeCompilation can retain the ambiguous
value and no future renderer has to be careful about it.

MATCH THE PATTERN YOUR OWN AUDIT ESTABLISHED. You showed the other sites are safe because their
INPUTS are validated or typed, not because their renderers are careful. So fix the value, at
construction, the way a nonempty SpanSet or a validated-nonblank calibration model is safe. A
careful renderer is a property of one function; a validated input survives the next person who
writes a second one.

PUBLIC TYPES IN TWO MODULES, so this needs the ADR scope new-engineer mapped rather than a quiet
edit. Read that map first. And when you gate, use the FULL reference scope from the merge base --
these are core and acquire types and the blast radius is wider than the two files.

EVIDENCE I WANT: a law that the ambiguous value is UNCONSTRUCTIBLE, not a test that today's
callers happen not to build it. The compiler slice already has a law that the two fingerprints
differ; yours should make that law true by construction rather than by rendering, and the two
should coexist rather than one replacing the other.

If new-engineer's review finds that canonicalizing breaks a real provider that reports an empty
version string meaningfully, that is a finding and not a failure -- bring it to me and we will
take option (b) as permanent rather than provisional.
